title: As Trump’s Midterm Deadline Looms, Gulf Countries Brace for Possible Renewal of Iran War
summary_full: The energy-rich Gulf Arab countries are engaged in a flurry of mediation efforts to avert war between the U.S. and Iran, as many fear that the fighting will be worse this time around.
